caseNameFull: Harris v. Dretke, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Correctional Institutions Division, 540 U. S. 1218

opinions.text: Application for stay of execution *953of sentence of death, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed further herein in forma pauperis granted. Motion for leave to file petition for rehearing denied.
